metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2000 · Il Mare
metas.description: In 1999, a voice actor moves from Il Mare, a seaside house, and leaves a Christmas card in its mailbox. An architecture student receives it in 1997, and a friendship separated by two years begins.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2009 · Thirst
metas.description: Through a failed medical experiment, a priest is stricken with vampirism and is forced to abandon his ascetic ways.
